required_documents.name: Passport
validation_rules: Must be valid for the duration of your stay
Must have at least one blank page for visa stamp

required_documents.name: Application Forms
validation_rules: IMM 5257 Application for Visitor Visa (Temporary Resident Visa)
All forms must be completed and signed

required_documents.name: Proof of Financial Support
required_documents.description: Evidence of sufficient funds for stay in Canada
validation_rules: Or proof of support from host in Canada
Minimum required funds vary by length of stay

required_documents.name: Travel Itinerary
required_documents.description: Details of planned travel to Canada
validation_rules: Hotel bookings or letter of invitation from host

required_documents.name: Letter of Invitation
required_documents.description: Letter from friend or family in Canada (if applicable)
validation_rules: Host's status in Canada (citizen or permanent resident)
Details of your relationship to host

required_documents.name: Proof of Ties to Home Country
required_documents.description: Evidence of strong ties to home country
validation_rules: Evidence of return to home country after visit
